dc_eval_cbrn.quote: we applied expert-designed and other targeted evaluations designed to assess whether the use of Llama 4 could meaningfully increase the capabilities of malicious actors

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Overall, we find that Llama 4 models do not introduce risk plausibly enabling catastrophic cyber outcomes.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Only automating cyberattacks, which is cyber; no replication or AI R&D.

ext_test_named_org.note: No outside tester named (AI Alliance, MLCommons are consortia, not testers).

safeguards_training.quote: The primary objective of conducting safety fine-tuning is to offer developers a readily available, safe, and powerful model

safeguards_runtime.quote: All of our [reference implementation](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-agentic-system) demos contain these safeguards by default

safeguards_access.note: Open weights under a licence; no safety-tied access restriction.
